text:
Maya L.: Flagging a gap from last week's pm: several actions missed their 30d check. Proposal: a lightweight 'escalation ladder' baked into postmortem actions. Thoughts?

Ravi S.: Yes — we've seen owners drift. Ladder idea = good. What do you mean by ladder?

Maya L.: Steps: owner ack -> reminder at 48h -> escalate to team lead at SLA/2 -> escalate to IC on SLA miss -> auto-create followup incident if SLA missed by >7d.

Evan - oncall: prefer automation rather than manual pinging. Could incident-bot create the followup incident and pre-fill fields?

incident-bot: [automated] I can create followup incidents and post digests. Need a small config: notify_channels, reminder_offsets, escalation_targets.

Maya L.: Proposed default config:
```
notify_channels: [#eng-oncall]
reminder_offsets_hours: [48, SLA/2]
escalation_targets: [owner, owner_team_lead, oncall_ic]
auto_followup_after_days: 7
```

Ravi S.: Add recurrence detection — if an action's tag shows up in 3 incidents in 180 days, escalate to "systemic" queue and require a root-cause audit owner.

Ops QA (Lina): From QA side, we want visibility into verification steps. Suggest adding columns: VerificationOwner, VerificationCriteria, EvidenceLink. Keeps closure meaningful.

Evan - oncall: Good idea. Also suggest a 'severity impact' field so we can sort outstanding actions by business impact when multiple SLAs collide.

Maya L.: Drafting a one-page template to include in the postmortem closure checklist:
- Action row as spreadsheet or issue
- Owner ack within 48h
- SLA_hours + escalation ladder
- Verification fields (Lina)
- Recurrence tag and threshold check
- Rotation owner to review outstanding actions weekly (IC rotation)

Ravi S.: Rotation note: Can we make the rotation owner responsible for weekly triage, and if >N items overdue escalate automatically? N=3 maybe.

incident-bot: [automated] Weekly action snapshot scheduled Fridays 16:00 UTC -> posts to #eng-oncall.

Ops QA (Lina): Can we pilot this on 10 postmortems and measure closure rate at 7/30/90 days? I'll help define the metrics.

Evan - oncall: I'll set up the sheet, incident-bot config, and a tiny Slack workflow for escalation pings. ETA: next Wednesday (1852680000).

Maya L.: Thanks. Final ask: every action should include an ETA and verification step before we mark closed. If anyone wants to be part of the pilot, DM Evan. :sparkles:
